svg.text: STM32MP257FAI3 ball map, colored by use on the EV1 (MB1936 rev E01)
TFBGA436, 22 x 22 grid, 0.8 mm pitch. Ball A1 is at the top left. Colors are named in the legend.
Display and camera (DSI, CSI-2, LVDS, control): 38 balls
Low-speed I/O and system (GPIO, UART, I2C, SPI, CAN, JTAG, boot, clocks): 81 balls
DDR4, stays on the SoM: 71 balls
Not connected on the EV1: 35 balls
